purpose: Describe regenerative-energy recovery using independently scoped complete aggregate and capped detailed drive evidence, without causal, savings, benchmark, or composite-score claims.
primaryGoal: Understand measured recovery share, monthly trends, per-drive distribution, temperature/starting-SoC associations, and coverage limitations for the workspace vehicle and date window.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-enabled query; vehicle/start/end participate in key; request receives AbortSignal. Aggregate supplies totalRegenWh, totalDriveWh, regenRatio, freeCharges, batteryCapacityWh and capacitySource. Frontend describes complete-window totals; backend aggregation and completeness were not inspected or exercised.

Vehicle-enabled query; bounded window key; safeArray select; FAST staleTime; inherited retry policy; AbortSignal forwarded. Exact returned rows feed the pure SI model. No pagination beyond the 1000-row sample is requested.

dataSources.owner: Existing workspace header and hooks; dated route registered at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:57
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle ID converted to string only for query interface. Vehicle timezone, all-time default, regen-efficiency.range persistence key and inclusive start/exclusive end are retained. No second page-local picker.
dataSources.limits: Hook internals and header controls were not exercised.

dataSources.owner: Existing data-trust infrastructure and page-specific presentation adapter
dataSources.behavior: Independent historical source trust; hasData admits retained payload, fatalError alone replaces content, refresh retry remains source-specific; disabled/unresolved queries are not success. StaleRefreshWarning also represents retained offline/blocked refresh.

Finite non-negative recovered Wh and finite positive drive Wh define eligibility; real zero regen is valid. Weighted ratios use summed operands, quartiles use interpolation, dates use selected timezone, 24 observed months display, six ratio buckets, five temperature and five SoC buckets, stable top-ten recovered-energy ranking. Input order and objects are not mutated.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one clearly visible page-wide cap explanation plus concise section-local scope references, preserving every limitation and all three sets of metrics/actions. Do not remove sections.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Assess composition through the current ChartCard/EmbeddedChart API, retaining both saved legend identities and complete six-column export/data alternative; do not flatten until equivalence is proven.

states.loading: Sections always mount. Independent source loading uses skeletons and null metric values. Brief loading uses BOTH queries loading for summary/overview, detail loading for coverage; per-source values are still guarded.
states.empty: Explicit no-evidence, missing response, no denominator, ineligible sample, pending detail, empty charts and empty ranked/context bodies. Unknown is not coerced into zero.
states.error: Fatal errors use independent QueryError and source retries; healthy neighbors survive. Summary supports retrying both sources when resolved empty.
states.staleOffline: Two StaleRefreshWarning instances are mounted outside brief/chart sections. Existing owner detects blocked refresh and retains payload; page briefs currently flag retained from refreshError only.
states.partial: Three briefs retain independent aggregate/detail availability and missing metrics; sourceStatus partly-available labels used by summary/overview.
states.success: SI raw operands remain in model; useUnits/useNumberFormatting/useDateFormat apply display preferences at presentation boundary.
states.disabledUnresolved: No vehicle leaves queries disabled; adapter does not promote them to success. Pending-detail explanations render.

issues.detail: Brief retained flag checks refreshError only, whereas StaleRefreshWarning recognizes other degraded retained statuses including offline blocked refresh. A brief may label source available while its adjacent shared notice says stale/offline.
issues.fix: Map existing DataState retained/degraded and refresh-blocked semantics into brief status without changing query policy or replacing retained data; preserve independent source distinctions.

issues.detail: aggregateReady checks resolution/error but not payload existence or the totalsUnavailable contradiction used by the adjacent aggregate body. With a valid detail source, overview status can report both sources available while aggregate body reports unavailable.
issues.fix: Derive readiness with payload and contradiction guards consistent with RegenSummaryBrief, preserving independently usable capacity provenance and detailed metrics.

sections.name: Selected-window evidence
sections.content: Six metrics: aggregate recovered Wh, aggregate recovery share, equivalent pack cycles, aggregate drive Wh, detailed returned rows, eligible/observed count; scope, provenance, cap, errors/empty and review drawer.

sections.name: Recovery overview
sections.content: Five metrics: estimated pack basis, capacity source, sample recovered Wh, sample drive Wh, weighted sample share with quartiles; complete aggregate gauge/operands and independent detailed sample, zero-aggregate contradiction notice.

sections.name: Monthly recovery trend
sections.content: Latest 24 observed months; energy bars and weighted-ratio line, dual axes, tooltip, legend; recovered/drive energy, ratio and eligible/returned counts in full alternative/export; truncation explanation.

sections.name: Recovery-ratio distribution
sections.content: Six ratio bins with counts and shares; median/IQR accessible description, tooltip, export frame and table alternative.

sections.name: Ambient-temperature context
sections.content: Five Celsius-defined buckets with display conversion, weighted ratio, eligible/returned and unavailable/invalid accounting.

sections.name: Starting-SoC context
sections.content: Five percentage-defined buckets with weighted ratio, eligible/returned and unavailable/invalid accounting.

sections.name: Most recovered energy by drive
sections.content: Top ten eligible drives; rank, drive date/ID, recovered energy, share, drive energy, distance, duration, speed, starting SoC and temperature; mobile summary retains full detail.

sections.name: Coverage and methodology
sections.content: Four accounting metrics: returned, eligible, excluded, unavailable energy fields; independent status badges, capacity provenance and six explanations: scopes, weighting, eligibility, months, descriptive associations, estimated capacity.

No source mutations, page-specific forms or enabled fullscreen prop in this mounted page.
dataBehavior: Independent aggregate and capped sample are never conflated into guaranteed lifetime detail.
History limit 1000, display-month limit 24 and ranking limit 10 remain explicit.
SI Wh/m/s/m/s/Celsius source operands unchanged; useUnits and specialist formatters only at display boundary.
Missing/invalid measurements differ from measured zero; positive energy denominator required.
Weighted totals, percentile interpolation, bucket edges, stable tie order and timezone monthly assignment preserved.
Raw query keys, AbortSignal, enablement, FAST detail staleTime and existing inherited retry policies preserved.
Retained data survives refresh failure; neighbor source failures remain independent.
Capacity estimate provenance and non-causal/non-savings methodology remain visible.
Stable identities: regen-efficiency.range, regen-selected-window-summary, regen-overview-brief, regen-coverage-brief, regen-monthly-recovery, monthly-recovery, driving:regen-ranked-evidence.
